edits.after: Janna has no early poke — your Q-plus-auto trades win the level-1 stand-off outright.

edits.before: Clone games begin: the lane's information war opens in your favor.
edits.after: Janna is still toolless at 2 — Q Blooming Burst plus auto out-trades her every walk-up.

edits.before: E threats live: the root into bloom chunks; pick one window per wave.
edits.after: Her Q Howling Gale is only a slow charge — E Tangle-Barbs roots her weak body before it matters.

edits.before: Disguise the margins — every wrong guess they make is tempo you banked.
edits.after: Janna stays purely reactive before items — keep shoving the poke lead through 4-5.

edits.before: Pop Blossom online — the disguise plus R turns brush control into ambush law.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
